title: Rook CephBlockPool
description: Schema for the Rook CephBlockPool Custom Resource Definition, which provisions Ceph RADOS Block Device (RBD) pools on Kubernetes. CephBlockPool defines the replication or erasure coding configuration, failure domain, device class, and mirroring settings for a Ceph block storage pool.

apiVersion.description: Kubernetes API version for the CephBlockPool resource

name.description: Name of the CephBlockPool resource, unique within its namespace

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the pool resource is deployed, must match the Rook operator namespace

labels.description: Key-value labels for organizing and selecting Kubernetes resources

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for storing non-identifying metadata

CephBlockPoolSpec.description: Specification for the CephBlockPool defining replication, erasure coding, and pool settings

failureDomain.description: The failure domain that Ceph should use to spread data across for fault tolerance. Common values are host, rack, or osd.

deviceClass.description: The device class the OSD backing this pool should belong to. Typical values are hdd, ssd, or nvme.

replicated.description: Replicated pool configuration for data redundancy through replication

erasureCoded.description: Erasure coded pool configuration for space-efficient data protection

parameters.description: Key-value parameters to set on the pool, passed directly to Ceph's pool configuration

mirroring.description: Pool mirroring configuration for replicating data to a remote Ceph cluster

quotas.description: Storage quota settings to limit pool capacity or object count

compressionMode.description: Inline compression mode for objects stored in the pool

enableRBDStats.description: Enable per-image RBD statistics reporting for block devices in this pool

name.description: Optional custom name for the Ceph pool. If not set, the pool name defaults to the CephBlockPool resource name.

ReplicatedSpec.description: Configuration for a replicated Ceph pool that maintains multiple copies of data

size.description: Number of copies of the data stored in the pool for redundancy. Minimum of 1, recommended minimum of 3 for production.

targetSizeRatio.description: Fraction of the cluster capacity allocated to this pool for capacity planning purposes

requireSafeReplicaSize.description: If true, Rook will raise an error if the pool replication size is less than 3, preventing unsafe single-replica pools

replicasPerFailureDomain.description: Number of replicas per failure domain. Used to define sub-failure domains when replicating across hosts within a rack.

subFailureDomain.description: Name of the sub-failure domain. Must be a child of the failureDomain setting.

hybridStorage.description: Defines where primary and replica OSD data is placed across different device classes

primaryDeviceClass.description: Device class for primary OSD (e.g. nvme for fast reads)

secondaryDeviceClass.description: Device class for secondary OSD replicas (e.g. hdd for bulk storage)

ErasureCodedSpec.description: Configuration for an erasure-coded Ceph pool that uses coding to protect against data loss with less overhead than full replication

dataChunks.description: Number of data chunks per erasure-coded stripe. Data is split across this many OSDs.

codingChunks.description: Number of coding (parity) chunks per erasure-coded stripe. The pool can tolerate this many OSD failures.

algorithm.description: Erasure code algorithm to use. Default is jerasure. Options include jerasure, isa, lrc, shec, and clay.

MirroringSpec.description: Configuration for mirroring pool data to a remote Ceph cluster for disaster recovery

enabled.description: Whether mirroring is enabled for this pool

mode.description: Mirroring mode. image mirrors individual RBD images; pool mirrors the entire pool.

snapshotSchedules.description: Schedule for automatic snapshot creation used for mirroring

interval.description: Interval at which snapshots are taken (e.g. 24h, 1d, 1w)

startTime.description: Start time for the snapshot schedule in ISO 8601 format

peers.description: Configuration for the remote Ceph cluster peer

secretNames.description: List of Kubernetes Secret names containing bootstrap peer tokens for the remote cluster

QuotaSpec.description: Storage quota limits for the Ceph pool

maxBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes allowed in the pool. Set to 0 for unlimited.

maxObjects.description: Maximum number of objects allowed in the pool. Set to 0 for unlimited.

maxSize.description: Maximum size of the pool expressed as a human-readable string (e.g. 10Gi, 1Ti)

CephBlockPoolStatus.description: Observed state of the CephBlockPool as reported by the Rook operator

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase of the block pool

conditions.description: Conditions representing the current state of the block pool

mirroringStatus.description: Mirroring status information from the Ceph daemon

lastChecked.description: Time of the last mirroring status check

summary.description: Summary of mirroring health and daemon status

lastChecked.description: Time of the last snapshot schedule status check

Condition.description: A Kubernetes-style condition representing a specific aspect of the resource state

type.description: Type of condition such as Ready or Progressing

reason.description: Short machine-readable reason for the condition status

message.description: Human-readable description of why the condition is in this state

lastTransitionTime.description: Time when the condition last transitioned
